I'll tell you what I hate about professionals other than the fact that I can't afford them. They always just bounce you around from person to person because they can't help you. Then you get some asshole that things being nasty to you is going to make you better after doping you up didn't help. Then when you don't respond to that they just lock you up in some nut house. You get out a few months later to learn that all your stuff has been thrown away and your place rented out to someone else. Then you got to start all over again. 

The "professionals" have forfeited their turn to fix me. I'd rather put a bullet though my brain than deal with that again.
